chiseledblocks_create.jei.line: The pixel line, on a Create belt or a depot: the Block Slicer cuts a block into 16 slices, the Slice Cutter a slice into 16 rods, the Pixel Crusher a rod into 16 pixels. 4096 pixels per block. Place each machine two blocks above the belt, with one block of air between them, and turn it with a shaft: it works as fast as the shaft turns (2 seconds per cut at 16 rpm), stopped it lets items pass.
chiseledblocks_create.ponder.tag.pixel_l: Machines that cut whole blocks into pixels
Cutting blocks into pixels on a belt
The three machines go two blocks above a belt or a depot, with one block of air between them
A shaft through their sides turns them: the faster it turns, the faster they cut
The Block Slicer cuts a block into 16 slices
The Slice Cutter cuts each slice into 16 rods
The Pixel Crusher crushes each rod into 16 pixels
4096 pixels come out of every block. Each machine only takes its own input, so one belt carries the whole line
chiseledblocks_create.ponder.pixel_depot: Using a pixel line machine on a depot
Each machine also works on a depot two blocks below it
The pieces stay on the depot, ready for the next machine or a funnel
Twice the speed, twice as fast: 2 seconds per cut at 16 rpm
Stopped, a machine leaves items alone and lets them pass along a belt
